description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Offspring's Revenge triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of it with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Tree of Perdition token, dealing 1 damage to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.
